newsitem.title: USA: NY talks with Merck's Medco break off.
newsitem.headline: NY talks with Merck's Medco break off.

text.p: The New York State Department of Civil Service said negotiations between with Medco Containment Insurance Co of New York pertaining to the Empire Plan Prescription Drug Program have been terminated.
The parties were unable to reach a final agreement and have mutually decided to end talks on a contract that was to have taken effect January 1, 1997, the department said.

To assure there will be no interruption of service, it said, the Department of Civil Service is making immediate plans to extend the current contract with CIGNA Corp to ensure continuity of service for plan enrollees.
The Empire Plan Prescription Drug Program provides prescription drug benefits to 758,000 state and local government employees and their dependents.
The department said the extension of CIGNA's contract is subject to the approval of the State Comptroller's Office.
The state will rebid the contract and issue a new request for proposal within this calendar year, the department said.
It noted the state is precluded from discussing the details of the talks or the bidding process.
